description: This file provides R language bindings and class/method definitions for integrating MLlib frequent pattern mining algorithms (FP-growth and PrefixSpan) with Spark. It includes class definitions, method implementations for model fitting, retrieving itemsets and rules, prediction, and pattern mining.

classes.name: FPGrowthModel
classes.description: Represents a fitted FP-growth model backed by a Java object.

classes.name: PrefixSpan
classes.description: Represents a PrefixSpan pattern mining process backed by a Java object.

methods.name: spark.fpGrowth
methods.description: Fits an FP-growth model on a SparkDataFrame with support and confidence parameters.

methods.name: spark.freqItemsets
methods.description: Retrieves frequent itemsets from a fitted FPGrowthModel.

methods.name: spark.associationRules
methods.description: Retrieves association rules from a fitted FPGrowthModel.

methods.name: predict
methods.description: Makes predictions on new data using a fitted FPGrowthModel.

methods.name: write.ml
methods.description: Saves a fitted FPGrowthModel to a specified path.

methods.name: spark.findFrequentSequentialPatterns
methods.description: Finds frequent sequential patterns in a SparkDataFrame using PrefixSpan.
